EXECUTIVE SUMMARY   RELIABLE SUPPLY. REAL IMPACT.
Built around uptime.
In Zimbabwe’s resurgent mining and construction economy, the difference between a profitable operation and a stalled one 
is rarely the orebody or the contract — it is the supply chain behind it. Idle excavators, a stripped-down elution circuit 
waiting on reagents, a grader off the road for want of a single filter: these are the silent costs that erode margins and delay 
national infrastructure.
Zieve Industries exists to eliminate that downtime. We are a Harare-based industrial supply and equipment partner 
delivering a single, integrated source for earthmoving and construction machinery, gold-processing elution plants, industrial 
chemicals, lubricants, and critical consumables. We do not simply sell equipment; we underwrite our clients’ uptime with 
genuine quality, technical depth, and a logistics footprint built for the realities of operating in Southern Africa.
For the mining house chasing recovery rates, the civil contractor racing a dam deadline, or the ASM cooperative formalising 
its gold output, Zieve Industries offers what fragmented suppliers cannot: a one-stop, technically credible, dependably 
stocked partner positioned exactly where the demand is. We are built for the moment Zimbabwe finds itself in — and 
engineered for the decade ahead.
A single, integrated source for heavy-industry operations.
Earthmoving • Gold Processing • Industrial Chemicals • Lubricants • Consumables

OUR COMPETITIVE EDGE   FIVE OPERATING PILLARS
What distinguishes Zieve Industries is not a single product line, but a way of operating built on five pillars:
Reliable Supply Chain — Our Harare base and disciplined inventory mean clients get what they need, when they need it. 
We exist to keep your operation running, not waiting.
Technical After-Sales Support — We stand behind every supply, from elution plant commissioning guidance to equipment 
spares and lubricant specification. Our support does not end at the invoice.
Genuine Quality Assurance — We supply authentic, fit-for-purpose products. Where counterfeit parts and substandard 
chemicals carry real operational risk, our commitment to genuine quality is a guarantee of performance.
One-Stop-Shop Convenience — Equipment, plant, chemicals, lubricants, and consumables under one accountable roof. 
Fewer suppliers, simpler procurement, tighter control.
Sector Specialisation — We understand mining, construction, and processing because we are built for them. Our team 
speaks the language of recovery rates, haul roads, and uptime.
Supply. Support. Quality. Convenience. Specialisation.

MISSION, VISION & CORE VALUES   THE STANDARD WE OPERATE BY
Our Vision
To be Southern Africa’s most trusted industrial supply partner — the name that mining, construction, and processing leaders 
rely on to keep their operations productive, profitable, and growing.
Our Mission
To deliver genuine, high-performance equipment, plants, chemicals, and consumables — backed by uncompromising 
technical support — that maximise our clients’ uptime, recovery, and return on every asset they operate.
Our Core Values
Reliability — We are measured by our clients’ uptime. Dependability is our first promise.
Integrity — Genuine products, honest counsel, and transparent dealing in every transaction.
Partnership — We succeed only when our clients do; we invest in long-term relationships, not one-off sales.
Excellence — Technical rigour and quality in everything we supply and support.
Growth — We are committed to building Zimbabwe’s industrial capacity, one well-equipped operation at a time.
